videos.subtitle_summary:
1.  Analyze the Request:
Source Material: A YouTube video transcript (Title: Buk-gu Gap Debate Turns into a 'Brawl,' Who Won? / Channel A / News TOP10).
Language Constraint: MUST respond ONLY in Korean. NO English allowed.
Length Constraint: Around 500 characters (Korean characters).
Content Constraint: Summarize the core content in 3-5 sentences.
2.  Analyze the Transcript:
Context: A political debate involving candidates (Han Dong-hoon is mentioned as a target, others attacking him).
Key Conflict: The debate heated up over the issue of who was responsible for requesting a 30-year sentence for former President Park Geun-hye.
Specifics:
Candidates attacked Han Dong-hoon regarding the 30-year sentence request.
Han admitted he was a prosecutor on the investigation team (led by Yoon Seok-youl) and involved in the trial, but stated he felt sorry humanely towards Park Geun-hye.
Another candidate (possibly Lee Jun-seok or someone else, context suggests a rival) challenged Han, asking if he was shifting blame to Yoon Seok-youl. They argued over whether Han attended the court personally.
There was a heated back-and-forth about whether the 30-year request was just law enforcement.
The debate got chaotic (microphones cutting off, candidates talking over each other), leading to an apology to viewers for the uneven broadcast.
Expert Commentary (Lee Hyun-jong): Explains that the "request for sentencing" (구형) is done by the prosecution as an organization, not just an individual prosecutor. At the time, the case was handled by the Special Prosecutor's office (investigation) but the sentencing request was handled by the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office where Han was a senior prosecutor. Park didn't attend court personally. The expert implies that while Yoon led the investigation, the sentencing request is a collective decision by the prosecution system.

Draft 1 (Mental Outline): The debate was intense. Candidates attacked Han Dong-hoon about the 30-year sentence for Park Geun-hye. Han admitted involvement but apologized humanely. The other candidate pressed him on whether it was just enforcement. The broadcast was messy.
